content.text: {"answer":"At most three upkeep runs can start per repository for one event (a push to main). Priority goes to the pull request upkept longest ago. A pull request that has never been upkept goes first. Next comes the one whose newest upkeep run started earliest, and then the oldest pull request. Before the 2026-10-25 change, the three oldest pull requests always won. When those three kept failing, they took every start on every push and starved the rest.","sources":["specs/external-floor/spec.md (FR12.19a, implementation-loop pipeline)","commit ba1abcf765b0b076f9ed937c5e6d724e4d36f027"]}
